title: Underwriting Fee Relief on a Mortgage Loan File Revised Loan Estimate by Mortgage Pre-Approval Level
content:
On a revised Loan Estimate for a Mortgage Loan File, underwriting relief is taken from the zero-tolerance charges according to the level of the Mortgage Pre-Approval the file was converted from — the pre-approval the loan file names as the one its application was converted from.

| Level of the Mortgage Pre-Approval the file was converted from | Underwriting relief taken off |
|---|---|
| Larkspur Underwritten Pre-Approval | the program's underwriting fee |
| Larkspur Jumbo Underwritten Pre-Approval | the program's underwriting fee |
| Larkspur Lock & Shop Pre-Approval | the program's underwriting fee |
| Larkspur Verified Pre-Approval | 300.00 USD |
| any other level, or no pre-approval the file was converted from | nothing |

**Clause.** Where the pre-approval the file was converted from is a Larkspur Underwritten Pre-Approval, a Larkspur Jumbo Underwritten Pre-Approval or a Larkspur Lock & Shop Pre-Approval, the program's underwriting fee (as listed in the Larkspur program fee schedule) is taken off; where it is a Larkspur Verified Pre-Approval, 300.00 USD is taken off; otherwise nothing is taken off.

Hypothetical illustrations: on a Larkspur High-Balance Conforming 30-Year Fixed file whose underwriting fee is 1195.00 USD, conversion from a Larkspur Underwritten Pre-Approval takes 1195.00 USD off and conversion from a Larkspur Verified Pre-Approval takes 300.00 USD off; conversion from a Larkspur Pre-Qualification takes nothing off.
